text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product image, pure white background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, no person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire object fully visible. Black cropped textured jacket over black crop top, black micro skirt , black knit leg warmers over black pointed knee boots.
original_prompt: Edit this wardrobe product photograph. Remove the white diagonal-striped hanging tie/panel from the front of the skirt entirely. Show a plain black micro skirt. Do not add a tie at the neckline. Preserve all other materials and cuts, pure white background, fully uncropped portrait 2:3. No human, visible body, face, hair, mannequin, stand or new objects.
reproduction_note: 根据服装参考生成无人商品展示。遮挡或未展示的细节采用保守补全；文字和品牌细节仅为视觉参考。未进行逐图重新生成相似度验证。
